ns2:course.label: Ethics and Educational Policy
ns2:course.description: Designed to prepare students to analyze ethical issues involved in educational policy making, policy administration, and policy evaluation; includes topics such as educational equity, privacy, due process, and compliance; draws upon multiple disciplines to analyze issues developed out of practice. Prerequisite: Open to students who have fulfilled their social foundations requirements and other students with consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Open to students who have fulfilled their social foundations requirements and other students with consent of instructor.
